newsitem.title: DENMARK: Novo still sees 10-15 pct 96 profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Novo still sees 10-15 pct 96 profit growth.

text.p: Danish drugs and biotechnology group Novo Nordisk said on Wednesday it left unchanged earlier expectations of a 10-15 percent rise in operating and pre-tax profits for whole year 1996.

The forecast came after it posted a 1.893 billion crown pre-tax profit for 1996's first nine months, four percent up on the same period last year and better than analysts' average expectations of 1.852 billion crowns.
For whole year 1995, Novo reported last March a 2.156 billion crown ordinary pre-tax profit.
